1.asv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

2.web: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
2.asv: How long wilt thou speak these things? Andhow longshall the words of thy mouth be like a mighty wind?

3.web: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
3.asv: Doth God pervert justice? Or doth the Almighty pervert righteousness?

4.web: If your children have sinned against him, He has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
4.asv: If thy children have sinned against him, And he hath delivered them into the hand of their transgression;

5.web: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
5.asv: If thou wouldest seek diligently unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;

6.web: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
6.asv: If thou wert pure and upright: Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

7.web: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
7.asv: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end would greatly increase.

8.web: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
8.asv: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And apply thyself to that which their fathers have searched out

9.web: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
9.asv: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow);

10.web: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
10.asv: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?

11.web: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
11.asv: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?

12.web: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
12.asv: Whilst it is yet in its greenness, and not cut down, It withereth before any other herb.

13.web: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man shall perish,
13.asv: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hope of the godless man shall perish:

14.web: Whose confidence shall break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
14.asv: Whose confidence shall break in sunder, And whose trust is a spider’s web.

15.web: He shall lean on his house, but it shall not stand. He shall cling to it, but it shall not endure.
15.asv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold fast thereby, but it shall not endure.

16.web: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
16.asv: He is green before the sun, And his shoots go forth over his garden.

17.web: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
17.asv: His roots are wrapped about the stone-heap, He beholdeth the place of stones.

18.web: If he is destroyed from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
18.asv: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

19.web: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others shall spring.
19.asv: Behold, this is the joy of his way; And out of the earth shall others spring.

20.web: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
20.asv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he uphold the evil-doers.

21.web: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
21.asv: He will yet fill thy mouth with laughter, And thy lips with shouting.

22.web: Those who hate you shall be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked shall be no more.”
22.asv: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the tent of the wicked shall be no more.
